limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.

justified_changes.initial_rtl: 32-bit history updates on rising clock edges; positive-edge asynchronous reset clears it. Rollback has priority and shifts the actual branch result into bit zero. Prediction shifts its result into bit zero; otherwise history holds. No extra latency or ports.
justified_changes.testbench: Independent arithmetic oracle checks rising-edge updates and stability before the edge, asynchronous reset and reset priority, holds, overflow after more than 32 predictions, rollback inputs and simultaneous prediction/rollback, plus randomized transactions. Bounded timeout and fatal comparisons included. No initial value is assumed before reset.

static_review: Interface, 32-bit truncation, nonblocking sequential assignments, asynchronous reset sensitivity and priority match the original specification.
